newsitem.title: USA: Nashville Country Club offers 2.6 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Nashville Country Club offers 2.6 mln shrs.

text.p: Nashville Country Club Inc said on Tuesday that it is offering approximately 2.6 million shares of common stock to raise funds for its acquisition of 51 percent of Avalon West Coast.
Proceeds from the offering are expected to be approximately $9.1 million, the company said in a statement.
The placement agent for the offering is Rauscher Pierce Refsnes Inc, the company said.
Avalon West Coast is a group of related entities which produce concerts and manage merchandising for concerts and sports events, Nashville Country Club said.
